policy: #897 derived-style audit. Every file in scope is audited through the production parseFile pipeline; the tree walk runs only under the rootNode.hasError gate the pipeline uses, and the two signals are cross-checked per file with disagreements recorded. Failure classes are derived from the parse tree; no hand-written limit map exists to drift.
